i.x: Today’s updated ballot count makes the message coming from Alaskans abundantly clear – we’re fed up with the high costs and corruption stemming from DC, and we’re ready to take our state back.
Alaska first. That’s what this campaign has been all about.

As tens of thousands of ballots are still being counted, I want to thank the poll workers, election officials, and volunteers across Alaska working to make sure every last one is accounted for. Your tireless work keeps our democracy safe and secure. Thank you!

Results are still coming in, and we are seeing some incredible numbers. In St. Mary's, more Alaskans voted for me on Election Day this year than voted at ALL in 2024. Thank you St. Mary’s, for the warm welcome earlier this year and for turning out to vote!

If you’re wondering why counting the votes takes so long – this is normal in Alaska. It’s a big state where more than 80% of our communities aren’t on the road system. And we’re going to make sure that every last ballot is counted, and every single Alaskan’s voice is heard.

I hope you're all enjoying the break from attack ads and political mailers as much as I am! The final ballots are still coming in, and we'll know more on Tuesday. But the data so far is clear – we have the clearest path to victory.
We are standing up and taking our state back.
Polls are open until 8 PM. If you are in line by 8, stay in line. If you are experiencing any issues or have any questions call the Voter Access Hotline at 855-498-6837.
